text:
elaine: Heads up — sparklines LCP ~2x in EU canary since the 10:00 deploy. Trace: https://perf.redwood/trace/abcd
matt: which deploy/shas?
elaine: canary-20260501-3 (frontend-ci). We rolled telemetry client sampler v2 + increased prefetch window.
anya: yep, rollout started at 10:00 -> 5% then 20% at 10:05 (rollout id r-2026-05-01-3).
frontend-ci: deploy_bot: canary-20260501-3 started by @anya at 1718000300
raj: looking at traces — main thread work spikes during chart hydration. Additional sync CPU from telemetry sampler plus larger bundle parse time.
elaine: perf log excerpt from a noisy instance:
```
[10:12:11] kvcache.evictions=0
[10:12:12] kvcache.evictions=12
[10:12:13] chart.hydrate.ms=240 -> 620
[10:12:13] telemetry.sampler.sync_start
```
anya: rollout change also bumped prefetch config: 
```
prefetch.windowMs: 2000 -> 10000
prefetch.maxBytes: 200KB -> 1MB
```
matt: that combination feels bad — more prefetch bytes -> bigger in-memory bundles -> kv cache pressure -> evictions -> more parse/compile on main. Telemetry sampler doing sync hooks makes it worse.
raj: agree. quick wins: make sampler async + batch events, and cap prefetch bytes per session. Also add eviction metric alert.
elaine: quick mitigation: rollback telemetry sampler v2 and revert prefetch.window to 2s in canary now.
anya: rolling back sampler v2 (canary) — starting rollback.
frontend-ci: deploy_bot: rollback canary-20260501-3 initiated by @anya at 1718000450
sre-bot: perf-alert: LCP returned to baseline in EU canary after rollback.
matt: Follow-ups (short): 1) async/batched sampler + feature flag 2) prefetch circuit-breaker (bytes + time) 3) KV eviction alert + dashboards 4) rollout UX: surface client-side perf delta per canary step
elaine: created ENG-4821 with perf traces and initial RCA notes: https://redwood/issue/ENG-4821
anya: I'll owner the postmortem and add a small UX change to rollout page to show client perf impact during canaries.
elaine: thanks all :thumbsup:
